### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default: **see table**. YAML selects the local numerical options; process-global study switches remain environment settings.
Recognized parser blocks reject unknown keys. Direct Python option construction bypasses YAML parsing, so hydro reset
rechecks gravity-work constraints.
:::

| key | default | coupling |
|---|---|---|
| `forcing/const-gravity/gravity-work` | cell | cell, face-wallc or face |
| `gravity-work-fixer` in that block | true for cell | requires radial-only gravity and nonperiodic x1; non-cell reset clears it |
| `grav1`, `grav2`, `grav3` | 0 | disabled flux direction zeros its gravity |
| `non-hydrostatic` | 1 | must lie in [0,1] |
| `dynamics/wb-wall-clamp` | true | required by balance_column |
| `dynamics/disable-flux-x1/x2/x3`, `verbose` | false | flux/source direction gates |
| `dynamics/equation-of-state/type` | moist-mixture | shallow-water bypasses radial WB |
| EOS `limiter` | false | positivity correction |
| EOS density, pressure, temperature floors | $10^{-6}$ kg m$^{-3}$, $10^{-3}$ Pa, 20 K | state floors |
| reconstruction vertical/horizontal `type,scale,shock` | dc,false,false | spatial reconstruction |
| `dynamics/riemann-solver/type,dir` | roe,omni | interface flux solver |
| `integration/implicit-scheme` | absent / 0 | accepts 0, 1, 9 only |
| `implicit-advection-cfl`, `shear-cfl` | 1, 0 | require active implicit scheme; positive / nonnegative finite values |
| `geometry/cells/nghost` | 1 | WB/XC with gravity requires at least 3 |
| `geometry/type` | cartesian | controls XC and corrected-work availability |
| `distribute/layout,nb1,nb2,nb3` | slab,1,1,1 | block decomposition |
| external x1/x2/x3 boundaries | reflecting | periodic x1 incompatible with active fixer |
| `forcing/fric-heat` | removed | explicit parse error |


### Derivation

No separate continuum equation is introduced by the parser. The configuration resolves into the schemes described
in the preceding sections. In particular, changing face work changes the budget functional; it is not just an
output label. Validation is part of the numerical contract because incompatible options must not silently run.

### Numerical method

Parse the recognized sub-blocks, instantiate component options, then reset hydro. YAML rejects a true fixer with
non-cell work and nonzero radial gravity; direct option construction is normalized by reset before its remaining
guards. Implicit non-cell work without an in-operator path warns. A missing implicit scheme returns explicit options;
setting its CFL controls without an active scheme fails.
